summary: Matrices coding both living species and extinct stem forms exist only as single-clade deposits (a Darwin-wasp matrix on Zenodo, a primate matrix on Dryad) and in MorphoBank, which returned 403 to scripted access. PBDB supplies dated occurrences and Open Tree supplies a living-species tree, but neither holds characters or stem/crown placements.
next_step: Pick a clade with a deposited fossil+extant matrix (e.g. the Zenodo Darwin-wasp NEXUS or the Dryad primate matrix), open the files, and pre-register the morphospace geometry test on it; or obtain MorphoBank matrices through a browser or the project export.
obstacles_confirmed: Morphospace geometry depends on character selection.
No repository found holds a ready cross-clade collection of crown+stem matrices; MorphoBank was not browsable by script.
